content.text: According to Guinness World Records, the longest-running video game franchise is **The Oregon Trail** (1971–present), and it was produced by **MECC** (Minnesota Educational Computing Consortium).

The longest-running video game franchise according to Guinness World Records is **The Oregon Trail**, which was produced by **MECC** (Minnesota Educational Computing Consortium), starting in 1974/1975.
